entities.summary: Giovanni Serafini was an Italian Cardinal. He was the Cardinal-Deacon of Santi Vito, Modesto e Crescenzio from 1843 to 1846 and then the Cardinal-Deacon of Santa Maria in Cosmedin from 1846 until his death in 1855.
